# Smart Garden ScalaTropy motivating use case

What we want to showcase about ScalaTropy in this motivating use case:

- [ ] Typed peer topology using different communication protocols
- [ ] Peer subtyping and groups with progressive specialization
- [ ] Usage of (all) ScalaTropy collective ommunication patterns:
  - [ ] point-to-point
  - [ ] isotropic
  - [ ] anisotropic
  - [ ] co-anisotropic
- [ ] choreography branching
- [ ] concurrent sub-choreographies

## Overview

```scala
object SmartGarden:

  type Server <: { type Tie <: via[MQTT toMultiple Device] & via[WebSocket toMultiple Dashboard] }
  type Dashboard <: { type Tie <: via[WebSocket toMultiple Server] }

  type Device <: { type Tie <: via[MQTT toSingle Server] }

  type Robot <: Device
  type LawnMower <: Robot
  type SpotSprayer <: Robot

  type Sensor <: Device
  type SoilMoistureSensor <: Sensor
```

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="max-width:100%;" />

## Grass cut routine

Hypothesis:

- this routine is automated

```plantuml
@startuml
''' Entities '''
actor Dashboard

control  Server

boundary "LawnMower*"
boundary "SpotSprayer*"

boundary "SoilMoistureSensor*"

''' Behavior '''

==Check environmental conditions==
activate Server
activate Dashboard

Server -> Dashboard : **isotropicComm**[Server, Dashboard](Checking)
Dashboard -> Dashboard : display

Server -> Server : check weather \nforecasts for next\n N hours : outcome

Server -> SoilMoistureSensor : **isotropicComm**[Server, SoilMoistureSensor](GetMeasurement)
activate Server
activate SoilMoistureSensor
SoilMoistureSensor -> Server : **coAnisotropicComm**[SoilMoistureSensor, Server](data)
deactivate SoilMoistureSensor
Server -> Server : process : outcome
deactivate Server

==Allocate work==
Server -> LawnMower : **isotropicComm**[Server, LawnMower](AskAvailability)
activate Server
activate LawnMower
LawnMower -> LawnMower : check battery \n
LawnMower -> Server : **coAnisotropicComm**[LawnMower, Server](availability)
deactivate LawnMower
Server -> Server : process \navailability : n
deactivate Server

Server -> Server : allocate: allocation

Server -> Dashboard : **isotropicComm**[Server, Dashboard](allocation)
Dashboard -> Dashboard : display

Server -> LawnMower : **anisotropicComm**[Server, LawnMower](allocation)
activate LawnMower
LawnMower -> Server : **coAnisotropicComm**[LawnMower, Server](ack)
LawnMower -> LawnMower : go!
LawnMower -> Server : **coAnisotropicComm**[LawnMower, Server](completion)
deactivate LawnMower

Server -> Dashboard : **isotropicComm**[Server, Dashboard](Completion)
Dashboard -> Dashboard : display

deactivate Dashboard
deactivate Server
@enduml
```

- [x] Typed peer topology using different communication protocols
- [x] Peer subtyping and groups with progressive specialization
- [ ] Usage of (all) ScalaTropy collective ommunication patterns:
  - [ ] point-to-point
  - [x] isotropic
  - [x] anisotropic
  - [x] co-anisotropic
- [x] choreography branching
- [ ] concurrent sub-choreographies
